data.name: Frontend (Gatsby/React)
data.description: User Interface for interaction, planning, and monitoring. Built with Gatsby and React.

data.name: Backend (Python/FastAPI)
data.description: Handles business logic, agent management, API services, and data persistence.

data.name: Web Server (FastAPI)
data.description: Exposes RESTful APIs for the frontend to interact with the backend services.

data.name: TeamManager
data.description: Manages the lifecycle and state of agent teams for different tasks.

data.name: DatabaseManager
data.description: Manages persistence of session states, configurations, and learned plans.

data.name: Agents
data.description: Core components responsible for executing tasks and interacting with various services.

data.name: Orchestrator
data.description: Lead agent. Manages co-planning with the user, task delegation to other agents, and overall execution flow. Handles replanning and user feedback.

data.name: WebSurfer
data.description: Agent for browsing the web, filling forms, clicking elements, and navigating sites.

data.name: Coder Agent
data.description: Agent for writing and executing Python code and shell commands in a sandboxed Docker environment.

data.name: FileSurfer
data.description: Agent for locating files, converting them, and answering questions about their content.

data.name: UserProxy
data.description: Represents the user in the agent system, facilitating communication and task delegation to the user.

data.name: Tools
data.description: Utilities and controllers used by agents to perform specific actions.

data.name: Playwright Controller
data.description: Tool used by WebSurfer for browser automation and interaction.

data.name: Docker Integration
data.description: Provides sandboxed environments for Coder agent execution.

data.name: Bing Search
data.description: Tool for performing web searches to gather information.

data.name: File System Tools
data.description: Tools used by FileSurfer for file operations.

data.name: CLI (`_cli.py`)
data.description: Command-Line Interface for running Magentic-UI tasks and managing configurations.

data.name: Plan Learning & Retrieval
data.description: Module for learning from previous runs and retrieving saved plans to improve task automation.

data.name: Action Guards
data.description: Mechanism for requiring user approval for sensitive actions performed by agents.
